name: io.github.sayod111/sayod111-intelligence-mcp
description: Ten tools for commerce, advisers, trust, healthcare, public bids, secured loans and biotech.

tools.name: commercepulse_audit
tools.description: Run a live read-only HTTP/2 technical audit on public e-commerce storefronts (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, Salla, Zid). When to use: qualifying agency prospects, checking active ad pixels (Meta, TikTok, Google), detecting missing Klaviyo or retention apps, auditing SEO/CRO defects, or validating public merchant emails via DNS MX. Performs live network requests (typically 5-25s for 1-5 URLs). Requires caller Apify API token via Authorization: Bearer header (or X-Apify-Token) billed on Apify Pay-Per-Event.

storeUrls.description: Array of 1 to 5 full HTTPS storefront URLs (e.g. ['https://www.allbirds.com']).

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum sample products to inspect per storefront (default 15).

extractContacts.description: Extract publicly listed business contact emails from storefront pages (default true).

verifyEmailMx.description: Validate extracted business email domains against live DNS MX records (default true).

tools.name: commercepulse_catalog
tools.description: Extract normalized product catalog rows, SKU pricing statistics, compare-at discount ratios, stock availability, and best-seller rankings from public storefronts (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, Salla, Zid). When to use: merchandising benchmarks, competitor SKU pricing analysis, or inventory checks. Performs live read-only HTTP/2 requests (typically 5-25s for 1-3 URLs). Requires caller Apify API token via Authorization: Bearer header.

storeUrls.description: Array of 1 to 3 full HTTPS storefront URLs (e.g. ['https://www.allbirds.com']).

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum catalog products to return per storefront (default 20).

tools.name: b2b_revenue_enrich
tools.description: Inspect public B2B company domains via live read-only HTTP/2 and DNS lookups, returning 97 structured fields: 110+ technology stack fingerprints, MX mail host (Google/M365), SPF validity, DMARC security posture, publicly listed corporate contacts, and agency ICP fit scores. When to use: enriching B2B accounts for Clay/n8n/CRM pipelines, auditing DMARC/SPF security gaps for MSPs, or detecting SaaS tech stacks. Live latency typically 8-25s for 1-5 domains. Requires caller Apify API token via Authorization: Bearer header.

domains.description: Array of 1 to 5 bare company domains without paths (e.g. ['stripe.com', 'linear.app']).

onlyPushQualified.description: If true, filters out domains below the ICP qualification threshold (default false).

tools.name: b2b_hiring_intent
tools.description: Read live open roles from public corporate career boards across Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, and BreezyHR, classifying 6 B2B buying intent categories, hiring velocity scores, and corporate contacts. When to use: identifying fast-hiring SaaS/enterprise accounts, detecting departmental expansion triggers, or tracking open roles for recruiting and outbound RevOps. Performs live read-only HTTP/2 fetches (typically 10-30s for 1-5 companies). Requires caller Apify API token via Authorization: Bearer header.

companyInputs.description: Array of 1 to 5 ATS board slugs or domains (e.g. ['ashby:linear', 'greenhouse:stripe']).

maxJobsPerCompany.description: Maximum open job listings to extract per company (default 10).

enrichCompanyContacts.description: Include publicly listed corporate contact metadata alongside job signals (default true).

tools.name: sec_ria_wealthpulse
tools.description: Rank SEC-registered advisers by assets, filter public disclosures and compare weekly filings. Returns 45 flat fields. Requires caller Apify access to sec-ria-wealthpulse.

tools.name: saas_trust_center_audit
tools.description: Read public trust center, certification and subprocessor disclosures. Returns 22 flat fields. Requires caller Apify access to saas-trust-center-audit.

tools.name: us_healthcare_kol_cms_enricher
tools.description: Read public CMS healthcare provider and payment records. Actor runs use the caller's Apify account via Authorization: Bearer.

npiNumbers.description: Batch list of 10-digit US NPI numbers validated locally via CMS Luhn check before querying CMS APIs.

specialties.description: Target medical specialties (top commercial specialties: Orthopaedic Surgery, Cardiovascular Disease, Medical Oncology, Neurology, Dermatology, Ophthalmology).

includeOpenPayments.description: Query official CMS Open Payments DKAN API for General/Consulting/Speaker payments by NPI.

includeMedicareUtilization.description: Query official data.cms.gov Medicare Part B provider summary and Revoked Providers list.

excludeRevoked.description: If true, exclude providers flagged in CMS Revoked Medicare Providers dataset.

minOpenPaymentsUsd.description: Optional minimum Sunshine Act payment threshold in USD.

maxResults.description: Cap on enriched provider records emitted (Free Apify plan preview caps gracefully at 50 records).

tools.name: us_sled_gov_bids_monitor
tools.description: Find public state and local government procurement notices. Actor runs use the caller's Apify account via Authorization: Bearer.

sources.description: Select public procurement networks: bonfire, socrata_nyc.

keywords.description: Optional case-insensitive keywords matched against title and description (e.g. ['software', 'cloud', 'cybersecurity', 'construction', 'consulting']). Leave empty for all open bids.

states.description: Optional state filter (e.g. ['NY', 'VA', 'TX', 'CA', 'MD', 'FL', 'IL', 'WA', 'CO', 'NC']). Leave empty for all covered agencies.

bonfireSlugs.description: Optional extra Bonfire portal subdomains (alphanumeric/hyphens only, e.g. ['fairfaxcounty', 'dallas', 'houston']) added to the 30-agency curated registry.

openOnly.description: If true, exclude closed, awarded, or expired solicitations.

postedWithinDays.description: For scheduled daily morning n8n/Clay alerts: return only bids posted within the last N days (e.g. 1, 3, or 7).

maxResults.description: Cap on returned solicitations (Free Apify plan preview caps gracefully at 50 rows).

tools.name: us_ucc_1_secured_loan_leads
tools.description: Find commercial UCC financing statements in Colorado and Connecticut. Actor runs use the caller's Apify account via Authorization: Bearer.

states.description: Supported keyless open-data states: CO (Colorado CDOS), CT (Connecticut SOTS).

filedWithinDays.description: Filter commercial liens filed within the last N days (e.g. 7, 30, or 90) for daily lending outreach.

lapseWindowDays.description: Optional refinance-window filter: return active liens lapsing within the next N days (e.g. 180).

collateralCategories.description: Optional filter: blanket_mca, heavy_equipment, fleet_trucking, medical_dental, ar_factoring, real_estate_fixture, general_commercial.

debtorKeywords.description: Optional case-insensitive substrings matched against debtor business organization names.

securedPartyKeywords.description: Optional case-insensitive substrings matched against secured lender or filing representative names.

maskedAgentOnly.description: If true, return only filings using known representative agents (First Corporate Solutions, CSC, CT Corporation, CHTD, Cogency).

maxResults.description: Cap on deduplicated commercial UCC leads emitted (Free Apify plan preview caps gracefully at 50 rows).

tools.name: us_biotech_grants_trials_fda510k
tools.description: Find public NIH award, clinical trial and FDA device records. Actor runs use the caller's Apify account via Authorization: Bearer.

sources.description: Select agencies to query: nih_reporter, clinical_trials, openfda_510k.

keywords.description: Keywords matched against grant titles, clinical conditions, or FDA device names (e.g. ['oncology', 'genomics', 'imaging', 'surgical']).

states.description: Optional organization/applicant state filter (e.g. ['MA', 'CA', 'NY', 'TX', 'NC']). Leave empty for nationwide.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year for NIH RePORTER v2 grant awards (e.g. 2026 or 2025).

recruitingOnly.description: If true, filter ClinicalTrials.gov v2 to RECRUITING and NOT_YET_RECRUITING studies.

minGrantAmountUsd.description: Optional minimum grant funding threshold in USD (applies to NIH RePORTER rows).

maxResults.description: Cap on total unified life-sciences signals emitted (Free Apify plan preview caps gracefully at 50 rows).
